take: Minnesota announced it recalled defenseman Carson Lambos and center Hunter Haight from Iowa (AHL) and placed defenseman Jared Spurgeon on injured reserve. Spurgeon averaged 22 minutes a night, and Minnesota has controlled 60% of the five-on-five chance quality with him on the ice, about 8 points better than without him. In the three games already played without him, Jonas Brodin moved in beside Hughes, David Spacek rose to 16:29 a night from 9:07, and Daemon Hunt rose to 16:13 from 12:07.
